headline: Does Record Q2 Results And AI-Driven Guidance Shift The Bull Case For Amphenol (APH)?

The company also issued upbeat third-quarter guidance, projecting US$9.30 billion to US$9.40 billion in sales, underpinned by strong AI-related IT datacom demand and contributions from recent acquisitions, including CommScope.
